data.long_meaning: Derived from the Slavic elements milo (grace, love) and dar (gift). Milanko means 'gracious gift' or 'loving gift'. The name Milanko carries the meaning “Gracious gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Milanko usually hope their child will grow to embody gracious gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
